title: Maximum Subarray
prompt:
Return the largest sum of any contiguous subarray (at least one element).

**Example**: `[-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4]` → `6` (subarray `[4,-1,2,1]`).

Kadane's algorithm — the running-best scan from the greedy lesson.

tests.note: all negative — must still take one element

hints: Seed both `best` and `running` with nums[0] — NOT 0, or all-negative arrays break.
At each element: `running = max(nums[i], running + nums[i])`, then `best = max(best, running)`.

solution.explanation: O(n)/O(1). `running` is the best subarray ENDING here; a negative prefix is dead weight, so restart when it drags the sum below the bare element. (Also readable as 1-D DP: dp[i] = best sum ending at i.)
